criteria.notes: Live Teams availability for a configured group, grouped by state, with the board reshaping as the headcount changes.
Follows the reference door-card and status-wall treatments without copying their styling.
Near-black board with saturated presence rings and a live rail; distinct from the other dark examples, which are tabular.
Names and state words carry at room distance; the hero and compact tiers grow both rather than adding rows.
Dark and light themes both verified, including presence colours against each background.
Long-names scenario shows names truncating cleanly rather than clipping or overflowing their tiles.
Verified 600x600 through 1920x1080 plus portrait and 1536x432; layout switches tier rather than shrinking.
Avatars degrade to initials when a photo fails, verified by the broken-photos scenario.
Only example bound to live presence, where state changes on its own rather than on a refresh cycle.
